budgetConversion.rule: HARD: total fleet below 8 EUR/h; GPU <= 2 EUR/h including tax assumption; Vast target provider, preserve model identity.

surveyScope.note: Five cheapest total-price offers per type are a sample; other hosts/VRAM variants and cheaper GPU-only prices may exist.

pricingMethod.conversion: Existing budget assumption: USD * 0.92 * 1.19; not a live FX quote or tax advice.
pricingMethod.gpuOnly: search.gpuCostPerHour, fallback dph_base; missing/nonpositive/nonfinite prices excluded.
pricingMethod.defaultDisk: dph_total/search.totalHour can include provider default disk. Not added to GPU-only price.
pricingMethod.roleDisk: Not quoted with allocated_storage for this survey. Full role disk must be priced separately; avoid double-counting.
pricingMethod.traffic: Usage-dependent inet_down_cost / inet_up_cost, USD per GB as reported; not part of GPU-only ceiling.
pricingMethod.historical: Historical quotes are retained for traceability and never counted as current confirmation.
